plugin.name: sonata-privacy
plugin._long: Screen capture, window control, the clipboard, virtual input, the lock screen and overlays only for Sonata (and the screen-sharing portal). Apps go through the portals, which ask first.

option.name: enforce
option._short: Hide them (off: only log what would be hidden)

option.name: trusted
option._long: Program names (space separated) that get them too: input methods, a VNC server, a status bar of one's own.
